name: APOLLO 15 — Hadley Rille and the Apennine Front

meta.site: Apollo 15 — Hadley Rille and the Apennine Front
meta.citation: NASA LRO LOLA + JAXA Kaguya TC merged DEM, 512 ppd (~59 m/px)
meta.grid: azimuthal equidistant about the site, resampled bilinear, long axis on bearing 121 deg
meta.resolution_note: source product is 59.225 m/px; this 1024x512 grid at 4 m/px spans 69 x 35 source posts and is a 15x bilinear resampling of them — interpolation, not added detail
meta.layout: row-major, +x along the traverse, +y to its left
meta.note: The first rover traverse, up the Apennine Front. Slope walking beside a 300 m sinuous rille.

blurb: The first rover mission, working up the Apennine Front beside a 300 m deep sinuous rille. Slope walking, where a lope stops being efficient and control matters more than range.
